finding.headline: "The Doorway-Freezer"
finding.problem: "I stand at the door holding the car seat for ten minutes. My mother would normally be telling me what to pack. I don't trust myself to go out alone with this tiny human."
finding.person: 6-weeks-postpartum first-time Nigerian mum in Lagos or diaspora, whose omugwo relative is abroad/unavailable, paralysed at the front door terrified she'll forget something or the baby will cry in public.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone product — "The 15-Minute Doorway Cure: Your First Solo Outing with Baby."". Verdict: PASSES (19/25).
